Portrait setting: Ground Beta, a full-scale training city on U.A.'s grounds. Behind the character, a wide empty street runs between mid-rise concrete and glass office blocks with blank storefronts and dark traffic signals; cracked walls and scattered rubble mark earlier exercises. The street narrows into the distance under a pale, hazy sky. No other people and no traffic. No readable signs or text.

Scenery only: the choice does not move the character, grant access or affiliation, or supply props. Respect the selected frame and keep exactly one foreground character.

Portrait lighting — Key: High midday sun slightly to one side, hard and white, with short shadows. Fill: Cool skylight from the open sky. Bounce: Light off the pale concrete street and building faces. Practical: None; the signals and windows are dark.
